title: SS-AID proof-of-concept: reference implementation, attack models and results
description:
Reference implementation, attack models and result files for the article Boundary Conditions: When AI Agents Need Decentralized Identity (IEEE Security & Privacy, manuscript SP-2026-06-0276).

The package contains the SS-AID prototype (DID and verifiable credential issuance, a policy enforcement point, dynamic capability tokens and a revocation registry), an OAuth 2.1 baseline, the cross-organizational attack model with a sensitivity sweep over its stipulated rates, the delegation-depth and scaling models, a Tamarin specification of the delegation rules, and every result file behind a number in the article.

The README maps each claim in the article to the script and result file behind it and labels each number as a measurement, a model output or a derived value. Two claims that did not survive re-examination are recorded as withdrawn.
